reason: Repository evidence identifies this plugin as a local scheduling utility centered on a DSH top-bar panel, with explicit features for daily/weekly/history task views, completion tracking, recurring tasks, and conversation linking. Because it focuses on UI task management and chat-linked workflow actions while storing data locally, it is best classified as a navigation panel utility with limited integration risk from local persistence.

summaries.zh: 这是一个在 DSH Web 顶栏提供日程面板的本地任务管理插件，用于记录任务、打勾完成、重复日程设置，并可与会话进行关联与跳转。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a local schedule panel to the DSH web top bar for managing tasks with completion tracking, recurring options, and conversation-linking actions.

capabilities: Displays a top-bar schedule panel with today, week, and history views.
Supports completing tasks, recurring schedules, and automatic rollover behavior for incomplete one-time tasks.
Allows linking schedule items with chat conversations and navigating back to linked conversations.
Provides agent command tools for adding, listing, updating, deleting, marking done, and linking sessions for tasks.
Persists schedule and completion-history data in a local JSON file.
